proposals.evidence: Turner gives Gujarati ãguṭhɔ thumb and Marathi ãgṭhī little finger/toe within aṅguṣṭha. These western survey aŋ(g)ṭi forms fit the same digit family, with source aspiration loss or simplification retained. The generic finger sense is supported by the Marathi and Oriya extension; this does not infer a ring meaning.
